t: Memo Re British Stowaway Returned To Shanghai From Kobe

pages.en:
Special Branch
(Foreign Section)

(C.I.D.) Office Notes

（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POL. C. I. D. REGISTER No. D. 1185. April 22, 1930... 23 - 4 - 30.）

Sir,

Reference the attached concerning a British stowaway returned to Shanghai from Kobe on the President Cleveland 18-4-30.

The man concerned, Frank E. Collins, is 18 years of age, and a native of Sudbury, Ontario, Canada, in which town he has relatives. Previous to January 1930 he was employed by the International Nickel Company, with a factory in his home town, as a labourer.

On January 11, 1930, he boarded the "Empress of Asia" at Vancouver as a stowaway and reached Honolulu where he lived for about three weeks. His quest for work being unsuccessful he boarded the freight ship "Stanley Dollar" as a stowaway, under the impression that the ship was sailing direct to San Francisco. During this trip, his presence on board was discovered and he was handed over to the Immigration Authorities at Manila, who shipped him to Hongkong where the competent Shipping Authorities investigated his case and forthwith returned him to Manila on the "President Jefferson." Permission for him to land in that port was refused therefore he was compelled to work his passage to Shanghai on the same boat. Arriving in this city, Collins was allowed to land but a few hours before the "President Jefferson" sailed, he again stowed away. During the journey from Shanghai to Kobe his presence on board was discovered and he was handed over to the authorities at the latter port. They in turn sent him back to Shanghai on the "President Cleveland."

Collins is at the present time being cared for at the Salvation Army Hostel, 12 Tsongchow Road until arrangements can be made for his employment locally or until he can

（刑事侦缉处）办公笔记

（印章：上海工部局警务处 刑事侦缉处 登记号 D. 1185. 1930年4月22日... 1930年4月23日。）

先生：

兹就附件所涉之事，即一名英国偷渡者于1930年4月18日乘“克利夫兰总统号”（President Cleveland）从神户被遣返至上海一事。

涉事男子弗兰克·E·柯林斯（Frank E. Collins），现年18岁，系加拿大安大略省萨德伯里（Sudbury）人，在该镇有亲属。1930年1月之前，他就职于其家乡设有工厂的国际镍业公司（International Nickel Company），担任劳工。

1930年1月11日，他在温哥华作为偷渡者登上“亚细亚皇后号”（Empress of Asia），抵达火奴鲁鲁，并在那里生活了约三周。因求职未果，他又以偷渡方式登上货轮“斯坦利·多拉尔号”（Stanley Dollar），误以为该船将直航旧金山。在此次航程中，他在船上的存在被发现，随后被移交给马尼拉的移民当局，后者将其运往香港；当地主管航运当局对其案件进行了调查，并随即通过“杰斐逊总统号”（President Jefferson）将其遣返回马尼拉。由于获准在该港口登陆的请求被拒，他被迫在同一艘船上以做工抵偿船费的方式前往上海。抵达本市后，柯林斯获准登陆，但在“杰斐逊总统号”启航前几小时，他再次偷渡上船。在从上海至神户的航程中，他在船上的存在再次被发现，并被移交给神户当局。后者随即将其通过“克利夫兰总统号”遣送回上海。

柯林斯目前正由位于通州路12号的救世军招待所收留照料，直至为其在当地安排就业，或直至他能
